title: Global Configuration Data Structure Passing
pattern: Making the parsed configuration data structure globally accessible across the entire application.
why_bad: Couples every low-level module to the representation details of the configuration file. Changing the file format or schema structure requires refactoring fields across the entire program.
detection: Direct raw field access of a global configuration static variable in multiple decoupled modules.
fix: Wrap the configuration data structure behind a thin API or trait, decoupling the application code from details of configuration parsing.
source: [2nd] Andrew Hunt_ David Hurst Thomas - *The Pragmatic Programmer_ Your Journey to Mastery*, 20th Anniversary Edition (2019, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Topic 32.
